info.title: LFX Insights Public API
info.description:
Public read-only endpoints that LF web properties can use to embed LFX Insights
project stats without requiring authentication.

Health scores use Health Score v2. If your integration was built on v1, see the [migration guide](/docs/api/health-score-v2-migration/).

Only the endpoints listed here are supported. Other `/api` routes, such as `/api/project/{slug}`
and `/api/widget/*`, are internal and can change without notice.

get.description:
Returns health and activity metrics for a project.

`healthScore` is the Health Score v2 total, out of `healthMaxScore`. It is null for unscored projects.
The four v1 category scores are deprecated. See the [migration guide](/docs/api/health-score-v2-migration/).

This endpoint is public and requires no authentication.

Rate limiting applies (default: 200 requests per 60 seconds per IP address).
Rate limit status is returned in the `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`,
and `X-RateLimit-Reset` response headers.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description:
The project slug. Matches the slug used in the LFX Insights URL —
e.g. `k8s` in `https://insights.linuxfoundation.org/projects/k8s`.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per window

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets

404.description: No project found for the given slug

example.message: Rate limit exceeded. Please wait 42 seconds before trying again.

get.description:
Returns a page of projects. Only the parameters and fields used to look up projects in batch by slug are documented here.

This endpoint is public and requires no authentication. Rate limiting applies (default: 200 requests per 60 seconds per IP address).
Rate limit status is returned in the `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`,
and `X-RateLimit-Reset` response headers.

parameters.name: slugs
parameters.description: Project slugs to return. Repeat the parameter (`slugs=k8s&slugs=korg`) or join the slugs with commas (`slugs=k8s,korg`).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of projects per page. Set it to at least the number of slugs to get every slug in one page. At most 100 when `healthBreakdown=true`, so split more than 100 slugs into requests of at most 100 each.

parameters.name: healthBreakdown
parameters.description: When `true`, each project includes its Health Score v2 category scores and `coveredCategoryCount`.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per window

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets

example.statusMessage: pageSize must be at most 100 when healthBreakdown=true

example.message: Rate limit exceeded. Please wait 42 seconds before trying again.

type.description: Whether this entry represents a full project or a single repository

slug.description: URL slug used to identify the project

isLF.description: Whether the project is hosted by The Linux Foundation

maturity.description: Maturity level (e.g. sandbox, incubating, graduated). May be absent for non-foundation projects.

healthScore.description: Health Score v2 total, in points out of `healthMaxScore`. Same value as `healthScoreV2`. Null when the project is unscored (fewer than 2 categories covered), archived, or one of a few special projects (e.g. the Linux kernel). Held the v1 score, out of 100, before Health Score v2.

healthLabel.description: Health Score v2 band of `healthScore * 100 / healthMaxScore`. Display this instead of grading `healthScore` yourself. Null whenever `healthScore` is null.

healthMaxScore.description: Points available for `healthScore`: 100 when all 3 categories are covered, or 60, 65 or 75 when Maintainer Health, Security & Supply Chain or Development Activity is missing. Null whenever `healthScore` is null.

maintainerHealthScoreV2.description: Health Score v2 Maintainer Health category score. Null when the project has no value for this category.

securitySupplyChainScoreV2.description: Health Score v2 Security & Supply Chain category score. Null when the project has no value for this category.

developmentActivityScoreV2.description: Health Score v2 Development Activity category score. Null when the project has no value for this category.

coveredCategoryCount.description: Number of the 3 Health Score v2 categories that have a score. Null when the count is not available, including for archived projects and a few special projects (e.g. the Linux kernel), which can still have category scores. Treat a null `healthScore` or `healthLabel` as unscored instead of inferring it from the category scores.

lifecycleLabel.description: Project lifecycle state, assessed independently of the Health Score. Null when not computed for this project.

contributorHealthScore.description: Deprecated v1 contributor score. Does not add up to `healthScore`. Use `maintainerHealthScoreV2`.

popularityHealthScore.description: Deprecated v1 popularity score. v2 has no popularity category. Use `starsLast365Days` and `forksLast365Days`.

developmentHealthScore.description: Deprecated v1 development score. Does not add up to `healthScore`. Use `developmentActivityScoreV2`.

securityHealthScore.description: Deprecated v1 security score. Does not add up to `healthScore`. Use `securitySupplyChainScoreV2`.

contributorCount.description: Total number of contributors, all time

organizationCount.description: Total number of contributing organizations, all time

softwareValue.description: Estimated value of the project's software in USD (COCOMO model)

contributorDependencyCount.description: Number of contributors that account for a disproportionate share of commits

contributorDependencyPercentage.description: Percentage of commits attributed to those contributors

organizationDependencyCount.description: Number of organizations that account for a disproportionate share of commits

organizationDependencyPercentage.description: Percentage of commits attributed to those organizations

firstCommit.description: ISO 8601 date of the earliest recorded commit

starsLast365Days.description: GitHub stars gained in the last 365 days

forksLast365Days.description: GitHub forks gained in the last 365 days

activeContributorsLast365Days.description: Unique contributors active in the last 365 days

activeOrganizationsLast365Days.description: Unique contributing organizations active in the last 365 days

starsPrevious365Days.description: GitHub stars gained in the 365-day period prior to the last 365 days

forksPrevious365Days.description: GitHub forks gained in the 365-day period prior to the last 365 days

activeContributorsPrevious365Days.description: Unique contributors active in the prior 365-day period

activeOrganizationsPrevious365Days.description: Unique contributing organizations active in the prior 365-day period

achievements.description: List of leaderboard rankings earned by the project (may be empty)

rank.description: The project's rank in that leaderboard

totalCount.description: Total number of projects in that leaderboard

ProjectListItem.description: A project in the list. Other project fields are returned but not documented here.

slug.description: URL slug used to identify the project

healthScoreV2.description: Overall Health Score v2, in points out of `healthMaxScore`. Always returned. Null when the project is unscored (fewer than 2 categories covered), archived, or one of a few special projects (e.g. the Linux kernel).

healthMaxScore.description: Points available for `healthScoreV2`: 100 when all 3 categories are covered, or 60, 65 or 75 when Maintainer Health, Security & Supply Chain or Development Activity is missing. Always returned. Null whenever `healthScoreV2` is null.

healthLabel.description: Band of `healthScoreV2Normalized`. Use it for display instead of grading the raw `healthScoreV2`. Always returned. Null whenever `healthScoreV2` is null.

healthScoreV2Normalized.description: `healthScoreV2 * 100 / healthMaxScore` on a 0-100 scale, for sorting and comparing partial and full scores. Always returned. Null whenever `healthScoreV2` is null.

maintainerHealthScoreV2.description: Health Score v2 Maintainer Health category score. Returned when `healthBreakdown=true`. Null when the project has no value for this category.

securitySupplyChainScoreV2.description: Health Score v2 Security & Supply Chain category score. Returned when `healthBreakdown=true`. Null when the project has no value for this category.

developmentActivityScoreV2.description: Health Score v2 Development Activity category score. Returned when `healthBreakdown=true`. Null when the project has no value for this category.

coveredCategoryCount.description: Number of the 3 Health Score v2 categories that have a score. Returned when `healthBreakdown=true`. Null when the count is not available, including for archived projects and a few special projects (e.g. the Linux kernel), which can still have category scores. Treat a null `healthScoreV2` or `healthLabel` as unscored instead of inferring it from the category scores.
